subject: Discovery recap + proposing rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposing rotating demo slots

Hi Alice  thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + suggested next steps: 

Recap
- Primary use case: multi-tenant SaaS search augmentation (reranking + embeddings) for customer support triage
- Key constraints: strict PII controls, EU data residency requirement for EU customer data, target 50ms p90 token latency for short responses
- Stakeholders: you (product), Dan Brown (tech lead), procurement later in the process

Next step: technical deep dive / demo with your engineering team (we recommend 45 minutes). To make scheduling easy across your global team, I wanted to propose a rotating weekly/demo schedule so the meeting time alternates between US-friendly, EU-friendly, and APAC-friendly slots. That helps share the inconvenience across teams and ensures at least one slot each region has a friendly local time.

Proposed rotation (repeat weekly, starting week of Oct 18):
- Week A (US slot): Tue 09:0009:45 PT / 12:0012:45 ET
- Week B (EU slot): Wed 16:0016:45 CEST / 15:0015:45 BST
- Week C (APAC slot): Thu 09:0009:45 SGT / 11:3012:15 IST

If that pattern works, we can start with the US slot the week of Oct 18 and rotate each week (US -> EU -> APAC). If you prefer we can set a cadence of every-other-week per region instead.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level milestones & owners).

Please confirm who from your engineering team should join (Dan? others) and which week/slot you'd like to start with. I also included a Calendly link if you'd rather pick a specific slot: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Thanks  looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Brown <dan.brown@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 02:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposing rotating demo slots

Hi Marissa  thanks for the clear notes and the proposed rotation. This looks good in principle. A few quick items: 

- Please include Dan (cc'd) from our side; he'll lead the technical session.
- Our team prefers EU-friendly times where possible. If we can start the rotation with the EU slot that would be ideal for our first session.
- We have one additional constraint: procurement wants a fortnightly cadence for vendor deep dives (they don't need to attend every week). Could we do weekly product/eng sessions but optionally make procurement/ops attend every other rotation?

If it's helpful, start with Week B (EU slot) the week of Oct 18. Dan and I are available Wed 16:0016:45 CEST that week. Please send a calendar invite and agenda.

Thanks,
Alice
Product Manager, Acme Solutions
alice.johnson@acme.com

Hi Alice  great, happy to start with the EU slot week of Oct 18. Quick note from the engineering side: for the technical deep dive we'd like to cover the following agenda (attached as tech-deep-dive-agenda.docx):

1) Architecture overview for serving: routing, model variants, and data residency options (10 min)
2) Integration patterns: embeddings, reranking, streaming responses, and SDK/REST examples (15 min)
3) Performance expectations: throughput/latency targets and sample benchmarks (10 min)
4) Q&A + next steps / MAP owners (10 min)

Logistics:
- Proposed single session (45 min) starting Wed Oct 20, 16:0016:45 CEST (Camila and I will both join from Redwood).
- If procurement wants to only attend every other rotation that's fine  we can share meeting notes and the MAP spreadsheet after each session.

Can you confirm Dan's timezone (CEST) and whether the proposed date/time works? Once confirmed I'll send the Google Meet invite.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
